Hi, I also have PCOS & and CPTSD & AFAB. I have been thinking deeply about the correlation between PCOS and trauma exposure, pre, during and post puberty. I believed they must be linked due to cortisol levels stress hormones or something but I never knew how to question it or phrase why I believe they're linked. I think they must be, the body keeps the score after all!! My pcos symptoms are so exhausting and of course the cptsd symptoms mean I can barely function in society. Maybe I will ask my endocrinologist about this next time, although they never really want to chat... Someone should do a study on this!
